verdict.rationale: Codex CLI explicitly recommends signing in with a ChatGPT account (Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise) to use Codex without an API key, with API key usage noted as an alternative requiring additional setup. This directly matches the story of personal-account sign-in without managing API keys, though the exact free-tier scope/limits aren't detailed. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a genuinely free tier (vs. paid ChatGPT plans) and independent corroboration of the login flow's simplicity.
